author: Donna Wood-Dudley
text:
In past instances... Abbott accessed data codes to verify the error codes and determine the cause.  10 years using fsl, all the series except the plus. I've never had issues with replacement sensors. 
Times they'd mail out replacement sensors required the compromised device sent back other times,  they would have pharmacy replace free of charge , off of existing refills. Falling off...may be more of a challenge 
Removal for medical procedure,  they will replace with no questions asked

author: Gene Holcombe
text: It depends.  Abbott will limit how many you can get.  If you abuse the process, they will stop providing replacements. Too many people don’t install it correctly and expect a replacement
